no_adcom_quote.quote: The Agency held no Advisory Committee Meeting regarding this application because the safety profile was expected to be comparable to that of other biologic products approved for this indication. There were no novel or complex regulatory issues that required public discussion at an AC meeting.

summary: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for the SKYRIZI (risankizumab) BLA761105 approval. The Multidiscipline Review's Section 8 states the Agency held no AC meeting because the safety profile was expected to be comparable to other approved biologics for this indication and there were no novel or complex regulatory issues requiring public discussion. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
